name: Exp_HLRSign
summary: This EA trades based on signals from the custom HLRSign indicator, which identifies overbought and oversold conditions using Highest Low Range levels. It opens buy positions on upward signals and sell positions on downward signals, with configurable entry/exit logic and money management modes.
summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义HLRSign指标的信号进行交易，该指标通过最高低价范围(HLR)水平识别超买和超卖状态。在向上信号时开多仓，向下信号时开空仓，具有可配置的入场/出场逻辑和资金管理模式。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于HLRSign指标，该指标利用最高低价范围(HLR)计算超买超卖水平，当指标值突破上轨(HLR_UpLevel=80)时产生买入信号，突破下轨(HLR_DnLevel=20)时产生卖出信号。入场条件分为两种模式：MODE_IN表示指标从信号线内穿越到外部时入场，MODE_OUT表示从外部穿越到信号线时入场。出场条件支持反向信号平仓，即当出现买入信号时同时平掉卖出仓位，反之亦然，也可以通过遍历历史K线寻找最近的反向信号来确认平仓。仓位管理提供了五种模式：自由保证金比例、余额比例、含浮亏自由保证金比例、含浮亏余额比例和固定手数，默认使用固定手数0.1手。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险敞口大小，并设置了1000点止损和2000点止盈来限制单笔交易的风险。该EA还包含新K线检测机制，避免在同一根K线上重复交易，并通过Deviation参数控制滑点容忍度。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the HLRSign indicator, which uses the Highest Low Range (HLR) to calculate overbought and oversold levels, generating buy signals when the indicator breaks above the upper level (HLR_UpLevel=80) and sell signals when it breaks below the lower level (HLR_DnLevel=20). Entry conditions come in two modes: MODE_IN triggers when the indicator crosses from inside the signal zone outward, while MODE_OUT triggers when it crosses from outside into the signal zone. Exit conditions support reverse-signal closing, where a buy signal simultaneously closes sell positions and vice versa, and the EA can also iterate through historical bars to find the nearest reverse signal for confirmation. Position sizing offers five modes: free margin percentage, balance percentage, loss-adjusted free margin, loss-adjusted balance, and fixed lot size, defaulting to a fixed lot of 0.1. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter to regulate risk exposure, with a 1000-point stop loss and 2000-point take profit set to limit per-trade risk. The EA also implements a new bar detection mechanism to prevent duplicate trades on the same bar and uses a Deviation parameter to control slippage tolerance.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理参数，控制交易手数或比例
parameters.description_en: Money management parameter controlling lot size or ratio

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式（自由保证金/余额/含浮亏自由保证金/含浮亏余额/固定手数）
parameters.description_en: Lot calculation mode (Free Margin/Balance/Free Margin with Floating Loss/Balance with Floating Loss/Fixed Lot)

parameters.name: BuyPosClose
parameters.description_en: Allow closing buy positions on signal

parameters.name: SellPosClose
parameters.description_en: Allow closing sell positions on signal

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: 信号算法模式（内穿外/外穿内）
parameters.description_en: Signal algorithm mode (Inside crossing Outside/Outside crossing Inside)

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 信号K线索引（0=当前K线，1=前一根已完成K线）
parameters.description_en: Signal bar index (0=current bar, 1=last completed bar)

pros: 具有完善的仓位管理模式选择，支持五种不同的资金管理方式，灵活适应不同风险偏好
入场和出场逻辑可独立开关控制，允许只开仓不平仓或只平仓不开仓等灵活配置
新K线检测机制避免在同一K线上重复开仓，减少过度交易风险
止损止盈参数完整，默认止损1000点、止盈2000点提供了1:2的风险回报比
通过BarsCalculated检查指标是否准备就绪，避免在数据不足时交易
pros_en: Comprehensive position sizing with five money management modes offering flexibility for different risk appetites
Independently toggleable entry and exit logic, allowing flexible configurations like open-only or close-only modes
New bar detection mechanism prevents duplicate trades on the same bar, reducing overtrading risk
Complete stop loss and take profit parameters with a default 1:2 risk-reward ratio (1000 SL vs 2000 TP)
BarsCalculated check ensures the indicator is ready before trading, avoiding trades on insufficient data
cons: 止损止盈为固定点数而非ATR动态计算，在不同波动率市场环境下适应性差
缺少点差过滤机制，在点差较大时可能导致不利成交价入场
历史K线遍历查找反向信号(第138-159行)在大量历史数据时可能造成性能问题
依赖自定义指标HLRSign但代码中未包含该指标的源码，可审计性和可移植性受限
静态变量Recount机制可能导致信号丢失，当CopyBuffer失败时仅设置重算标志而不重试
cons_en: Fixed-point stop loss and take profit rather than ATR-based dynamic calculation, poorly adaptable across varying volatility regimes
No spread filter mechanism, potentially entering at unfavorable prices during high-spread conditions
Historical bar iteration to find reverse signals (lines 138-159) may cause performance issues with large bar counts
Depends on custom HLRSign indicator without included source code, limiting auditability and portability
Static Recount mechanism may cause signal loss; when CopyBuffer fails it only sets a recount flag without retrying
improvements: 将止损止盈改为基于ATR的动态计算，使风险管理能自适应市场波动率变化
添加点差过滤和交易时间过滤，避免在不利条件下入场
improvements_en: Replace fixed stop loss/take profit with ATR-based dynamic calculation for adaptive risk management across volatility regimes
Add spread filter and trading session filter to avoid entering under unfavorable market conditions

risk_points: 历史K线遍历循环无上限保护，当Bars_很大时可能导致长时间阻塞
固定点数止损在低波动率品种上可能过大，在高波动率品种上可能过小
SignalBar=0时允许在未完成K线上交易，信号可能频繁变化导致错误入场
risk_points_en: Historical bar iteration loop has no upper bound protection, potentially causing long blocking when Bars_ is very large
Fixed-point stop loss may be too wide for low-volatility instruments and too narrow for high-volatility ones
SignalBar=0 allows trading on an incomplete bar where signals may flicker, causing erroneous entries

summary_en: This EA trades based on signals from the custom HLRSign indicator, which identifies overbought and oversold conditions using Highest Low Range levels. It opens buy positions on upward signals and sell positions on downward signals, with configurable entry/exit logic and money management modes.
